title: Feeling Kinda Cube
description: Simply adds emotions to sulfur cubes
body:
This mod adds emotions to Sulfur Cubes.

These poor souless gooey creatures deserve to have some respect. Instead of filling them up with blocks, this mod fills them up with emotions. So at least you will feel guilty every time when you try hitting them. 

You may occassionally find them with different emotions when you're exploring in the Sulfur Caves. Each emotion has their own weight, providing some exclusivity.

If a sulfur cube with unique emotions is killed, the babies will inherit the emotions when they grow up.

Sulfur Cubes currently inherits 7 emotions and each has a random chance for the cubes to inherit.
- Moderate (48%)
- Annoyed (12%)
- Awkward (12%)
- Peace (12%)
- Scared (9%)
- Shy (6%)
- Oof (1%)
